dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline curve on the posterior margin from the basal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the terminal peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree inclination relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.3 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, broad convex arc fitting the anterior-dorsal curve of the head.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust protrusion with length approximately 1:1 with its base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope terminates and the rostrum begins.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant specular reflections and high-intensity glare across the dorsal and lateral skin surfaces.
